أَدِيبٌ Characterized by what is termed أَدَب [or good discipline of the mind and manners, &c.; i. e. well-disciplined, well-educated, well-bred, or well-mannered; polite; instructed in polite accomplishments, or an elegant scholar; &c.]: (T, S, M, Mgh, K:) pl. أُدَبَآءٍ. (M, K.) ―
-b2- See also مَؤَدَّبٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
